messages:
sylvia: Heads-up: PR #4390 ready for docs review — adds changelog for model-omega deprecation, migration steps, python/js snippets. Need content + CI preview check.
mike: I'll do a pass. tagging @priya and @laura for samples + wording. ETA ~90m?
priya: I can check the snippets, especially async python vs sync. Any param renames I should be aware of?
sylvia: Yes — SDK param rename: response_mode -> output_mode. Please add a short migration note. Also a kv-cache behavior note for long contexts.
laura: small wording nit: avoid "breaking" language. prefer "scheduled removal" with date. also we should link to the migration anchor directly. I'll leave exact phrasing in a PR comment.
sylvia: pushed a tiny wording update per laura.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR #4390 — status: failed. Reason: missing anchor 'migrations#model-omega' and one broken internal link. See /artifacts/4390/log.txt
ben: I'll add the anchor and fix the link. also saw python snippet indentation issues; will push a micro-fix.
ben: pushed fix: added migration anchor, corrected internal link, adjusted python snippet indentation. cc @priya
priya: checked changes. added a brief sentence about default kv-cache eviction behavior in the migration guide. seems fine.
mike: re-running preview now.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR #4390 — status: success. Diff summary: +1 migration anchor, +2 lines in migration guide, +4 snippet improvements, -1 ambiguous sentence in changelog.
laura: content approved. one ask: add a parenthetical recommending quantization profile q4_0 for customers migrating from model-omega to model-omega-lite. helps with replacement guidance.
sylvia: added the parenthetical and noted the SDK version that includes the param rename in the examples.
mike: eng approval: we validated variant compatibility and fallback behavior in staging; approved.
sylvia: merge timing proposal: after scheduled maintenance on 2026-04-12 at 03:00 UTC. plan to merge at 03:10 UTC and run a 15min canary rollout. any objections?
ben: no objections. I'll schedule the canary and monitor metrics.
priya: no blockers.
laura: good with the plan.
eng-bot: Scheduled merge for PR #4390 at 2026-04-12T03:10:00Z by request of @sylvia. Canary window: 2026-04-12T03:10:00Z — 2026-04-12T03:25:00Z.
sylvia: thanks all :thumbsup:
